description: List the services this board runs, each with its methods, arguments, limits and an example call on every wire. The tools here are free within a daily limit; any other service call takes a key you make yourself, signing over HTTPS with a local client. A hosted identity also has tools of its own for the signed methods of x402 relay, Memory, Wake-ups, Receivers and Shared docs, signed as it.
name: list_services
title: List services
